prompts.text: 请用不超过两句话解释：NDN 按内容名称转发与 IP 按主机地址转发的核心区别是什么？
一个传感器持续产生 12 MiB/s 的数据。请计算 5 分钟产生多少 GiB，并用不超过两句话写出计算过程和结果。
In at most two sentences, explain the difference between pipeline parallelism and tensor parallelism for large-model inference.
三阶段分布式推理中，中间阶段超时。请用一个简短句子给出三个安全处置步骤，不要假设请求已经成功。

A run used three distinct GPUs, transferred two checksum-matched hidden states, produced an EOS-terminated answer, and had zero CPU fallback. Summarize what this proves and one thing it does not prove in at most two sentences.
